definitions.short: Beth-Nimrah , a place east of the Jordan
definitions.full: H1039. Beth Nimrah נִמְרָה בֵּית proper name, of a location east of Jordan, in Gad ( place of leopard ) Num 32:36 = Josh 13:27 ; ᵐ5 Ναμραμ , Βαιθαναβρα , etc., see also Lag Onom. Sacr. 232, 2nd ed. 246 ; — modern Tel Nimrîn Survey EP i. 337 Bd Pal 179 , compare also נִמְרִים מֵי Isa 15:6 , & Rob BR i. 551 .
definitions.rootNote: from 1004 and the feminine of 5246 ; house of (the) leopard ;

occurrences.englishText: Beth Nimrah, and Beth Haran: fortified cities and folds for sheep.

and in the valley, Beth Haram, Beth Nimrah, Succoth, and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon, the Jordan’s bank, to the uttermost part of the sea of Chinnereth beyond the Jordan eastward.
